name: XXL STRIP
author: L'Cronx
summary: Channel strip in the style of a classic large-format British console (4000 E / G style): input drive, high- and low-pass filters, four-band EQ in three models (E Brown, E Black, G), compressor, gate / expander and a VU meter. 56 presets. By L'Cronx, GPL-3; the E-model filters and EQ are Dusk Audio's. Not endorsed by the makers of the originals.
